mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary easing reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations through lower borrowing costs.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day S&P 500 returns remains below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window or correlation with returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp monthly or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past month indicate broad-based demand contraction, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both HOUST and RSAFS decline monthly or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a monthly industrial production (INDPRO) decline exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals supply-side constraints, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to inflationary pressures and policy tightening.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines > 0.5% monthly or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher retail sales level (RSAFS) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as strong consumer spending supports corporate earnings growth and reduces recession risk.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when RSAFS is high or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) increase exceeding 2.5 percentage points signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) declines signal severe labor market stress, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced household income and consumption.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines monthly or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), a monthly federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase exceeding 0.1 percentage points triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to heightened risk aversion and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in monetary tightening cycle when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp monthly or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.
